notes.title: Update 0.4.0.0
notes.content:
Dear Engineers,

We're excited to push our first update out since resuming development.

Today we're bringing some commonly requested features and improvements, thanks to everyone who is contributing with their ideas and feedback on the forums and on our friendly [url=https://discord.gg/4uXT5uxHqC]Discord[/url] server.

[h3]Offset Changes[/h3]
We've changed the Offset operation to now support all 3 axis and increased the maximum amount of offset available to 0.5m, this should make life easier when building intricate models.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/edf6e2d9413835dee6e41cab94d15f644b3c2eef.gif[/img]


[h3]Component Spawner Additions[/h3]
Component Spawner now features two new properties:
[list]
[*]Lifetime: Allows you to define a time after which the spawned component will auto-destroy
[*]Force: Applies a force to the spawned object
[/list]Now you can finally make that tennis ball thrower you've been dreaming about!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/e09762c152f3f824e25abe8b7a26390f94de51b3.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
In no particular order:
[list]
[*]Gamepad Interface: Added 'Enabled' property to quickly enable/disable input
[*]Raw Mechanic Components: Added 'Friction' property to allow for things like buttery smooth bearings or strong brakes 
[*]Character Movement: Added ability to change volume of character movement sound
[*]Device Controller: Added 'Reset' Command to allow resetting a Device through Sketch (useful in Staged worlds)
[/list]

As always please let us know if you find any issues or have any suggestions.
Thanks!

notes.title: Milestone 1 - Closed Loops
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/25deee1acb25be00c817b32ee57c39de0b7ada72.png[/img]

Hey there Engineers!

It’s already been 2 months since the Early Access release, it has been amazing to see what the community is coming up with and the creativity and ingenuity shown by creators on the Workshop. On our end we’ve been hard at work fixing bugs and closely following the community’s needs, and today we’re happy to finally reach our first milestone: [b]Closed Loops![/b]

One of the unique aspects of Plasma is its physics engine, which uses articulated bodies to simulate joint movement - a technology normally used in robotics simulations due to its accuracy and rigidity.
One of the downsides however is the inherent inability to form closed mechanical loops - until now! By making use of a rigid body constraint between the articulated bodies we can form closed loops, these won’t be as rigid as the rest of the Device but work very well in most scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/7e830ab8f1d87ac135a916dfda3921dde1d445f7.png[/img]

When two [b]Joiners [/b]belong to the same group and are overlapping, a temporary mechanical join can be formed.

When the [b]Joiners [/b]belong to the same Device, mechanical loops become possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/522ce4ba1c789291afdb881c0df82d6923631194.gif[/img]

Joins can also be made between separate devices!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/caba0a3d101278f3a548afa0b8d0675fb4528eb5.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/9962b579a1a032192f485dc302ccbd0df29e63a9.png[/img]

A [b]Separator [/b]works a bit differently from a Joiner, it is designed to split off parts of a Device during simulation, think along the lines of a rocket shedding its boosters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/87b8bd893b0720b8b5c1e0cefba6ef52d25b5bf8.gif[/img]

Or a drone separating from another vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/03fd8676f6dc0dd4f88b8d55987573c0c408e863.gif[/img]

[h3]Force/Torque Outputs[/h3]
All mechanical components with an internal link (ex: Hinges, Motors, Extenders) now output their applied force at the last simulation step, a very useful piece of information in robotics applications and a prerequisite for self-balancing robots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/61aec4a31646e4cab8108f6a1c1e724662d144f7.gif[/img]

[h3]Linear and Angular Drag Fix[/h3]
The kind folk over at Unity 3D (the game engine we use) fixed a bug that caused linear and angular drag values to be applied incorrectly to articulation bodies during simulation.
This update includes the fix, but we had to revert linear drag values to the default in your saved Devices so you might need to re-adjust the value if you had previously changed it.

[h3]Showcase World[/h3]
We also published the world containing all the devices you see here, so you can try them out yourself. The world is called "[b]Closed Loops Showcase[/b]" and its ID is [b]2988402150[/b].

[h3]Roadmap Updated[/h3]
Since we reached our first milestone, we've also updated our roadmap to show you what we have in store!

[url=https://plasma.game/roadmap.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/5c284a7f963c5337498692399088b3c35f90855d.png[/img][/url]

That's it for our first milestone!
We hope you'll enjoy this update and we can't wait to see what you'll come up with!

- Marco, Patrick, Jói, Javier, Michele, and Merlo

notes.title: Minor Update - 0.3.1.1
notes.content:
Welcome to another exciting update. The drones at PlasmaLabs Inc. are especially proud of this one!

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the "[b][i]Net Link[/i][/b]" component: it allows you to execute web requests. You can use it to talk to REST servers and retrieve or post data. It supports text and images. We are pretty excited about this one!
[*]Added the "[b][i]Hex Arch[/i][/b]" and "[b][i]Semi Hex Arch[/i][/b]" components. They fit very well with the glass components we added in the previous update.
[*]Added the "[b][i]Mini Docking Station[/i][/b]" component. It's basically a smaller and less intrusive version of the "[b][i]Docking Station[/i][/b]" component.
[*]Added the "[b][i]JSON Inspector[/i][/b]" node. You can use it to query or traverse a JSON blob. The perfect companion for the "[b][i]Net Link[/i][/b]" component!
[*]Added the "[b][i]Sound Fetcher[/i][/b]" node. It allows you to get a sound asset by its name.
[*]Added the "[b][i]Text Array Converter[/i][/b]" and "[b][i]Number Array Converter[/i][/b]" nodes to easily go from Text to TextArray or NumberArray, and viceversa.
[*]Added the "[b][i]Component Checker[/i][/b]" node to be able to check if a specific component exists on the device.
[*]Added an "[b][i]Autosize"[/i][/b] property to both the "[b][i]Label[/i][/b]" and "[b][i]Emissive Label[/i][/b]" components.
[*]Added a button on both Device and World popups to open the Steam overlay on the selected workshop item.
[*]Improved the "[b][i]UI Button[/i][/b]" node. It now allows you to have a payload that is output when the button is clicked.
[*]Improved the "[b][i]Text Manipulator[/i][/b]" node. You can now escape and unescape URLs.
[*]Improved nodes documentation: thanks to the help of members of our fantastic community, here's another batch of manuals for a bunch of nodes. These will keep coming with each update. Credits: @Alinto, @Azim, @Cracer, @FliX, @Gingerbread, @Leonardo1123, @PlasmAlex, @Super_IronMan, @vvmvx, @Zarro.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the game restarting in Fullscreen after previously setting it to Window mode.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Settings window that would show the wrong display's refresh rate.
[*]Exiting Ghost Mode will no longer disable flying mode.
[*]Fixed lasers on sensors not passing through opened sliding doors.
[*]Sharp notes no longer sound louder than other notes.
[*]Favorite icon in the Node Library now behaves correctly.
[*]NumberArray data type now obeys the Decimal Digits property in various components and nodes.
[*]"[b][i]Range[/i][/b]" property of light emitting components now has a lower limit of 1 to avoid a Unity bug that would turn the light off.
[*]Double line spaces in nodes manuals should work correctly now.
[*]Fixed the "[b][i]LCD[/i][/b]" component not updating its background color correctly.
[*]Rotated images in the Image Importer window now scale correctly.
[*]A few other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Plasma - v0.3.1.0
notes.content:
Welcome to this new juicy update brought to you by our beloved drones at PlasmaLabs Inc.!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/1176de7effc1d985de2adff1c386ec9f1788961f.gif[/img]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a batch of new components called "[b][i]Glass Part[/i][/b]": these components are designed to be used on vehicles as canopies, but we know you'll find all kinds of other uses for them!
[*]Added a few new Basic components: "[b][i]Flat Rod L Junction[/i][/b]", "[b][i]Quarter Tube[/i][/b]", "[b][i]Quarter Tube Window[/i][/b]", "[b][i]Semi Tube[/i][/b]", "[b][i]Semi Tube Window[/i][/b]", "[b][i]Semi Tube Corner[/i][/b]" and "[b][i]Ramp Corner[/i][/b]". You should be able to create interesting devices with those tube components!
[*]Added the "[b][i]Despawner[/i][/b]" component: similar to the Death Ray, but smaller, quieter and doesn't have a cooldown. Designed to be used in factory-like scenarios (or when you want to silently destroy devices).
[*]Added the "[b][i]Square Screen[/i][/b]" component: a square version of our beloved Screen!
[*]Added the "[b][i]Button Triangle[/i][/b]" component: a triangular version of the Button.
[*]Improved the "[b][i]Sphere 1/8[/i][/b]" component: it can now be scaled in any direction.
[*]Improved the "[b][i]Speaker[/i][/b]" component: you can now control the octave of any sound played by the Speaker; in addition to that, we added a property to control whether the player's position should affect the sound volume.
[*]Improved the "[b][i]Component Spawner[/i][/b]" component: you can now control the volume of the sound played when a new component is spawned. And yes, you can set it to OFF.
[*]Added a new node called "[b][i]Swapper[/i][/b]": this node allows only one signal (out of two: Primary and Secondary) to pass. It's the counterpart of the "[b][i]Router[/i][/b]" node[i].[/i]
[*]Improved the "[b][i]Text Manipulator[/i][/b]" node: we added the "[b][i]Join[/i][/b]" command to join all the elements of a Text Array into a single string, and its counterpart, the "[b][i]Split[/i][/b]" command to... split a text into an array of elements.
[*]Improved the Tree Line overlay: now "[b][i]Controller[/i][/b]" components are shown with their own icon to easily spot them.
[*]Improved the Guru Meditation window: it's now possible to skip saving the current world after the game has crashed.
[*]Improved nodes documentation: thanks to the help of members of our fantastic community, here's the first batch of manuals for a bunch of nodes. These will keep coming with each update. Credits: @Alinto, @Azim, @Cracer, @Gingerbread, @Leonardo1123, @Super_IronMan, @vvmvx, @Zarro.
[*]A few other small enhancements here and there.
[/list]
[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the system responsible to catch infinite loops in Sketches (it now actually catches them...).
[*]Fixed the search in the both the Device and World browsers for local items.
[*]A few other minor fixes.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added a batch of new components called "Glass Part": these components are designed to be used on vehicles as canopies, but we know you'll find all kinds of other uses for them!

Added a few new Basic components: "Flat Rod L Junction", "Quarter Tube", "Quarter Tube Window", "Semi Tube", "Semi Tube Window", "Semi Tube Corner" and "Ramp Corner". You should be able to create interesting devices with those tube components!

Added the "Despawner" component: similar to the Death Ray, but smaller, quieter and doesn't have a cooldown. Designed to be used in factory-like scenarios (or when you want to silently destroy devices).
Added the "Square Screen" component: a square version of our beloved Screen!
Added the "Button Triangle" component: a triangular version of the Button.
Improved the "Sphere 1/8" component: it can now be scaled in any direction.

Improved the "Speaker" component: you can now control the octave of any sound played by the Speaker; in addition to that, we added a property to control whether the player's position should affect the sound volume.
Improved the "Component Spawner" component: you can now control the volume of the sound played when a new component is spawned. And yes, you can set it to OFF.
Added a new node called "Swapper": this node allows only one signal (out of two: Primary and Secondary) to pass. It's the counterpart of the "Router" node.

Improved the Tree Line overlay: now "Controller" components are shown with their own icon to easily spot them.
Improved the Guru Meditation window: it's now possible to skip saving the current world after the game has crashed.

Improved nodes documentation: thanks to the help of members of our fantastic community, here's the first batch of manuals for a bunch of nodes. These will keep coming with each update. Credits: @Alinto, @Azim, @Cracer, @Gingerbread, @Leonardo1123, @Super_IronMan, @vvmvx, @Zarro.

notes.title: Plasma - v0.3.0.3
notes.content:
The drones at PlasmaLabs Inc. have been working hard for the past few days to bring you this amazing update! Enjoy!

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a "[b][i]Lock / Unlock Device[/i][/b]" system: while looking at a device in Wireframe, press U to toggle between locked and unlocked. When a device is locked, it cannot be moved while it's in wireframe. Use this to avoid moving or rotating devices by mistake.
[*]Added an "[b][i]FPS Feel[/i][/b]" to the Settings popup: turn it on to remove the momentum of your character and get a more instantaneous type of movement.
[*]Added a "[b][i]Time Controller[/i][/b]" node: use it to get current in-game time info and also system time info. You can use it to set the in-game time as well, but only if you're not in a Staged world.
[*]Small redesign of the Pause Menu: finding the button to go back to the Tutorial should be easier now; plus other small changes.
[*]Added a "[b][i]Console[/i][/b]" window in the Sketch: if you get a notification in the bottom left corner (log, warning or error), you can now click on it and get a list of all notifications received since the last reset of the device.
[*]Added a "[b][i]Test Mode[/i][/b]" to the Communicator component to simulate data transmission between two peers.
[*]Some components are now labeled as "[b][i]Experimental[/i][/b]": this means the component is new and might not work correctly or might not be fully implemented.
[*]Added a "[b][i]Save Reminder[/i][/b]" notification: it will pop up every 30 minutes to kindly remind you to save the world you're working on :)
[*]The Image Importer will not try to scale up or down an image if it's already of the correct size (680x512).
[*]Small improvements to Homebase biome and icons.
[*]Default Feed Interval of the Camera component is now 0.
[/list]
[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed one of the most recurring crashes: if a variable in a sketch was deleted, and it was still used in a component, and then a new component was attached to the device, the game would crash. In addition to this, the Guru Meditation window would try to save the world, which would now be corrupted, leading to another crash while trying to load it back.
[*]Fixed another "popular" crash: a GPS Tag component switched to wireframe would sometime lead to a crash when trying to read its position.
[*]Fixed a crash when deleting a freshly duplicated component.
[*]Fixed a crash that would happen when the player was interacting with a Button (or similar component) while docked and being teleported back.
[*]Fixed a crash with the Undo action.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Player Connector component wouldn't output 0 at least once when the scroll wheel stopped moving.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Raw Servo and Raw Hinge wouldn't output anything trough the Target Reached port.
[*]Fixed the lighting on the Moon biome: now the sun won't illuminate objects from beneath the biome any longer.
[*]Fixed naming of some components.
[*]Bunch of other small things!
[/list]

tags.feature: Added a "[b][i]Lock / Unlock Device[/i][/b]" system: while looking at a device in Wireframe, press U to toggle between locked and unlocked.
Added an "[b][i]FPS Feel[/i][/b]" to the Settings popup: turn it on to remove the momentum of your character and get a more instantaneous type of movement.
Added a "[b][i]Time Controller[/i][/b]" node: use it to get current in-game time info and also system time info.

Added a "[b][i]Console[/i][/b]" window in the Sketch: if you get a notification in the bottom left corner (log, warning or error), you can now click on it and get a list of all notifications received since the last reset of the device.
Added a "[b][i]Test Mode[/i][/b]" to the Communicator component to simulate data transmission between two peers.
Added a "[b][i]Save Reminder[/i][/b]" notification: it will pop up every 30 minutes to kindly remind you to save the world you're working on :)

tags.balance_change: Default Feed Interval of the Camera component is now 0.

tags.bug: Fixed one of the most recurring crashes: if a variable in a sketch was deleted, and it was still used in a component, and then a new component was attached to the device, the game would crash.
Fixed another "popular" crash: a GPS Tag component switched to wireframe would sometime lead to a crash when trying to read its position.
Fixed a crash when deleting a freshly duplicated component.
Fixed a crash that would happen when the player was interacting with a Button (or similar component) while docked and being teleported back.
Fixed a crash with the Undo action.
Fixed a bug where the Player Connector component wouldn't output 0 at least once when the scroll wheel stopped moving.
Fixed a bug where the Raw Servo and Raw Hinge wouldn't output anything trough the Target Reached port.
Fixed the lighting on the Moon biome: now the sun won't illuminate objects from beneath the biome any longer.
Fixed naming of some components.

notes.title: Changes since the Demo
notes.content:
As some of you know, Plasma was part of Steam Next Fest in October 2022, when we had a Demo of the game available to try out for a 3 week period.
We are often asked what has changed since the Demo, loads of things went in (too many to list!) but we'll focus on the more important changes.

[h2]Homebase[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/8aa2503631fed01826960d46fe039b17042eb152.png[/img]
We added a special world called [i][b]Homebase[/b][/i], a reference point for players to always come back to and explore. This is the first place players visit when finishing the tutorial, and is designed to be the place you return to when you finish playing a Staged World or just want to relax in a familiar setting.

[h2]New Components[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/07ad9a5b175bc20735d231484a97ac994be7d63e.png[/img]
We added a lot of new components that you can have fun building with, here are some highlights:
[list]
[*] [b]Color Sensor[/b] - It senses and outputs colors
[*] [b]Component Spawner[/b] - It spawns a Component 
[*] [b]Color Painter[/b] - Allows you to automate the coloring of Components
[*] [b]Zero Gravity[/b] - Disables gravity on the Device it's attached to
[*] [b]Holographic Screen[/b] - A neat new screen with no frame and transparent background
[*] [b]Death Ray[/b] and [b]Self Destructor[/b] - Components that allow you to destroy Devices
[*] [b]Communicator [/b]- Allows you to send/receive data in real-time between Steam players
[/list]
[h2]Handheld Devices[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/f061982b83510656f8259b5add0c18a3f93ac934.png[/img]
Using a special new Component, the Player Connector, we opened up the possibility of building handheld devices that mount to the player, allowing you to build all kinds of handheld fun! A good example of this is found in the Homebase, keep an eye out for it!

[h2]New Biomes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952921/4c47c12fa4f0e3f155da256f67fcb3a25bc3bef9.png[/img]
New exciting Biomes to build in!
[list]
[*]Mars
[*]Moon
[*]A new huge (and we mean huge!) Lab world - totally flat and empty!
[/list]
[h2]Staged Worlds[/h2]
We overhauled and put a lot of work into the Staging tools. With these you can define a number of permissions in the World, effectively allowing you to create a specific experience to share with other players.
These could be challenges, puzzles, stories, adventures, explorations, whatever you can think of you can make it happen in a Staged World.
In fact, the Tutorial and Homebase you experience in the game were made using the same tools we give you.

[h2]New Lua integration[/h2]
By popular demand we switched to Luau for our Lua implementation which allowed us to add:
[list]
[*] Image creation and per-pixel manipulation
[*] Proper table and array support
[*] Better support for out-of-the-box Lua functionalities
[*] Huge performance increase
[/list]
[h2]Custom Palette[/h2]
Some players found the in-built color palette too limiting, so we added the ability to edit the palette and customize it to your liking! Want to make that vomit green robot you've always dreamed of? Well now you can, while also annoying our art director at the same time!

[h2]Lots of Quality of Life improvements[/h2]
Too many to list! But, just for you, here's a short list of some we can actually remember:
[list]
[*]Added Array data type to Sketch (Number Array and Text Array)
[*]Texture resolution increased to 680x512
[*]Device maximum link capacity increased from 64 to 256 (a link is a moving part)
[*]Configurable linear/angular drag on Devices
[*]Documentation for some of the more complex nodes (Lua, Math Expression, etc.)
[*]Thousands of bug fixes! Millions!
[*]All the other things we can't remember!
[/list]

It's been an incredibly long journey for the team to get to where we are now (over 5 years, in case anyone's keeping count) - we are so very excited for the Early Access release and can't wait to see what you will build in your engineering playground!

Thanks for reading!
